question: You’ve said that the archbishops are mostly scum, but what were you thinking about when you thought them up?
answer: Just from saying Deadly Sin, you know they’re a bad bunch, I’d think. So, their personalities and such are divided up seven ways and easily-understood, right? So, when you add in the thing called ‘Love’, what kind of warped bunch do you end up with? -> Everything’s rotting nicely!
